column3: requireScopeValidForRole (#3546) reads the role's AssignableScope (mutable since Phase 2: an admin can change it) and, for an environment scope, which project the environment belongs to (never changes). A scope change never touches existing grants, so a grant that passes the check and commits after a concurrent scope change equals the serial order grant-then-change: the same rows, and the startup notice lists the grant if it is now outside the scope. AssignUserRole re-runs the check at its own write and its own locked SoD check. A concurrently deleted environment is the same outcome as a grant that committed just before the deletion.
